description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git operations, specifically focusing on the behavior of 'skip-worktree' feature in Git. It contains setup routines, test case definitions, and commands that automate testing various aspects of worktree management in Git repositories.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Prepares the repository state with a file '1' that is removed and marked with skip-worktree, setting up for absent case tests.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Prepares the repository with a file '1' containing 'dirty', marked with skip-worktree, for dirty state tests.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Verifies that the file '1' is in a dirty state as expected in the test setup.
